info.name: Look up publishers joined to your program

params.name: requestor-cid
params.description: CID of the company you are making the request for. You must be a member of that company.

params.name: date-accepted
params.description: Date the publisher accepted the program terms, YYYY-MM-DD.

params.name: publisher-name
params.description: Joined publisher's name. Must be more than 3 characters.

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the publisher's location.

params.name: special-incentive
params.description: Whether the publisher runs an incentive / special program. Only the value `yes` (case-insensitive) is allowed.

items.docs: Advertiser-side lookup of the publishers in a program — program terms and join status, promotional methods, websites and PIDs, categories, EPC and network rating. Exactly one search criterion must be supplied alongside requestor-cid. The request URI must be encoded per HTML 4 form content encoding rules. Advertisers only. Documented call limit: 25 calls per minute.
